Published: **https://laoujin.github.io/Atlas/research/2026-06-03-facilitation-logistics-failure-modes/**

The artifact covers:
- **Pre-workshop logistics** — GitHub Codespaces prebuilds, per-participant AI API key provisioning with hard budget caps ($2–5), and a participant pre-check gate sent 72 hrs before
- **Facilitation roles** — Lead / Producer / Helper(s) (one per breakout room), with a hard rule that the Lead never touches Zoom controls
- **Session structure** — 90-min ceiling, 60–70% hands-on split, a timestamped run-of-show, parking lot for off-topic threads
- **Expert audience dynamics** — the four root causes of senior-dev AI scepticism and what actually moves them (peer credibility > mandates, concrete first win < 5 min)
- **Failure modes table** — 10 rows covering env setup failure, API key failure, lecture creep, dominant voices, tool sprawl, and more, each with a specific prevention action
